facts.activity_file: insulating, guarding and signing hot surfaces

control_failures.control_label: insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: unplanned release of thermal energy at PSV-8210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HOT_SURFACE_GUARDING: the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-8210 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in protecting people from hot surfaces, specifically insulating, guarding and signing hot surfaces. PSV-8210 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 4 March 2006 a near hit was recorded on PSV-8210 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during start-up after maintenance; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
